title: React Server Components — Next.js App Router Scaffold
title_es: React Server Components — Scaffold de Next.js App Router
description: Runnable Next.js 15 App Router scaffold reproducing the guide's RSC patterns: parallel data loading with cache() dedup, Suspense streaming, server actions with useActionState/useOptimistic, and nested error boundaries.
description_es: Scaffold ejecutable de Next.js 15 App Router que reproduce los patrones RSC de la guía: carga de datos en paralelo con dedup de cache(), streaming con Suspense, server actions con useActionState/useOptimistic y boundaries de error anidados.
